        * * SQL Data Type: nvarchar(MAX)
        * * JSON Type: TestEntityEntity_IMyConfig`),
    Items: z.any().describe(`
        * * Field Name: Items
        * * Display Name: Test Field
        * * SQL Data Type: nvarchar(MAX)
        * * JSON Type: Array<TestEntityEntity_IMyExtra>`),
    Settings: z.any().nullable().describe(`
        * * Field Name: Settings
        * * Display Name: Test Field
        * * SQL Data Type: nvarchar(MAX)
        * * JSON Type: TestEntityEntity_IMySettings`),
